messages:
anya: Heads-up: Enterprise customer (FinRegCo) needs a POC covering EU + APAC. Key asks: strict data residency for EU, APAC must either stay in APAC or we provide clear egress pricing, in-region KMS, and predictable failover routing. Can we map what we can commit for the POC and a pricing delta? Need answers for their security RFP too. cc @mike @sarah
ryan: Timeline/size? we can attach a committed capacity quote but need qps + token/sec to size.
anya: They want to start in ~2 weeks, target POC duration 4w. Traffic ~50 req/sec peak, ~5 avg tokens per req, mostly chat generation. Post-POC they may move to Dedicated reserved. They asked if we can guarantee no subprocessor outside EU for EU tenants.
mike: Short answer: Hosted API = we cannot promise zero subprocessors outside customer region (cloud infra + monitoring partners). For strict EU-only, recommend Dedicated pinned to eu-west-1 or Private deployment. Those let you avoid using cross-region subprocessors. KMS: EU cloud KMS is available; APAC in-region KMS is still partial (apac-1 is in beta). For absolute control use Private + customer-managed keys (CMK).
mike: Example routing policy we can encode in the platform config: 
``
route_policy:
  - match: region=EU
    endpoint: eu-1.redwood.example
    kms: eu-kms
  - match: region=APAC
    endpoint: apac-1.redwood.example
    kms: apac-kms-beta
  - fallback: global-hosted
```
mike: Failover behavior notes: we support tenant pinning -> region. If capacity exhausted you can choose: (a) allow fallback to a compatible model in another region (not EU-only), (b) queue/deny requests, or (c) fail open to global-hosted. For their compliance ask, fallback must be disabled (or documented acceptance required).
sarah: Legal note: For any EU residency claim we must ship the subprocessors list + DPA annex. Cross-border egress requires explicit contractual consent. For KMS, customer-managed keys require audit language & KM access clauses; I can draft RFP answers.
ryan: Pricing roughs: Hosted (no guarantees) = baseline. Dedicated reserved (monthly commit) = +40–60% depending on GPU profile. Private + CMK = additional setup + infra; one-time onboarding fee likely. Will firm up once Mike sends sizing.
anya: Can someone run a quick cost calc for a 4w POC at 50qps with batching? Need line items: compute, egress (APAC->EU if applicable), KMS ops. Any latency impact if APAC traffic routes to EU?
mike: Quick ops notes: batching reduces tokens/unit cost but increases p99 by a bit. APAC->EU RTT adds ~80–120ms extra network latency + model time. Egress billed per GB by cloud provider; rough egress est will come from billing team (I'll request). KMS ops are minor per-request ops but depends on key wrapping frequency.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: New POC workspace 'finregco-poc' created by anya at 2024-11-12T09:12Z :white_check_mark:
ryan: Thanks — @sarah pls push RFP answers and subprocessors list. @mike pls post an ops runbook for the POC (autoscale, pins, fallback disabled) by EOD so I can include in the customer proposal.
sarah: On it — sending subprocessors list + DPA draft in ~1h.
mike: Ops runbook stub: autoscale min=2,max=6, batch_size=16, kv_cache=enabled, tenant_pin=true, fallback=disabled_for_tenant. Will attach full config + cost estimate in ~3h.
anya: Perfect. I'll schedule kickoff with customer for next Wed. Ryan, include Dedicated delta and Private + CMK option in the proposal. Thanks team :pray:
